match.diff: AssertionError: Can't find ability to activate command: Cast $CARD

ruling: XMage's Swat Away reduces its cost with SpellCostReductionSourceEffect.setCanWorksOnStackOnly(true), so TestPlayer's playable check (before the spell is on the stack) prices the cast at the full {2}{U}{U} and refuses a cast paid from the {U}{U} the scenario adds; gorge applies the reduction when the total cost is determined, so {U}{U} is correct. A driver gap, not a gorge defect.
source: Swat Away (static#0.0), reported by lb-xharness 2026-10-12 after the active-player driver fix; XMage side not reproducible in a seat
